# The English names that the dialog of menu 259 edits: the model name and
# comment, a bone, a morph, and a display group; the save of the enhanced
# model writes them. Both OK and Cancel apply the edits (ApplyEnglishNameDialog).
load model .\lips.pmd

english open
dialog text 667 "Lip Model"
dialog text 668 "English comment of the lip model."
dialog select 669 1
dialog text 672 "Neck bone"
dialog select 673 1
dialog text 676 "Mouth i"
dialog select 677 0
dialog text 680 "Face group"
dialog ok
save pmd english.pmd
save pmm english.pmm

english open
dialog text 667 "Cancelled Name"
dialog cancel
save pmd cancelled.pmd
